meta.title: 微信会话互通 (WeChat Session Bridge)
meta.description: Umbrella bundle: installing this one package brings both the WeChat Session Bridge reminder and the @xmanrui/dsh-im WeChat bot. With several sessions running, approval, question and task-finished each raise one in-app floating card in the bottom-right corner with real content (click to jump to that session, with a sound cue); only the sessions you are NOT looking at raise alerts, and it does not depend on system notification permission. Two event classes have separate configurable timeouts (choice/approval 60s, task-finished 30s by default); if neither switching to the session nor clearing the pending item happens in time, a richly formatted WeChat card (task-finished / needs-choice / grants-permission) is pushed as a fallback. v1.9.0 feature fusion: on timeout, a richly formatted WeChat card (task-finished / needs-choice / grants-permission) carrying the session tag and /session switch command is pushed per pending item. Multiple DSH sessions share a single WeChat account, you send /session <sessionId> in WeChat to switch to another session and keep chatting, and the full model answers are delivered back by dsh-im two-way sync — enabling realtime interaction directly in WeChat. The settings page uses draft + Save buttons on two cards with three-state buttons following the archive plugin. Real reply-back and option cards are handled by dsh-im native synced questions.
